title: Normalized transport from finite and integral operation families
statement: Given finite and integral operation families and compact-support left realizations, there exists a normalized ExceptionalIntegralScalar.Transported record at a compactification.

source.place: Constructions 4.1 and 5.25, Lemma 5.22 and Propositions 5.24 and 5.26

proof.text: Apply strict-system exceptional transport and normalized reduction/total-limit reconstruction at each finite coefficient field, conjugating the system adjunction through the reconstruction equivalence and retaining its actual units, counits, finite evaluations and common bounds.
Use simultaneous proper/open system realization and its normalization to supply the integral left realization and whole-system equations required by Transported.
Package the operations, adjunction, evaluations, reductions and normalization maps into Transported.

proof_origin.place: Constructions 4.1 and 5.25, Lemma 5.22 and Propositions 5.24 and 5.26

mathlib_searches.results: No existing construction of the Transported record was found.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_for_operations
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s)) :
    Nonempty (ExceptionalIntegralScalar.Transported l Ω D hl c
      operation left)
